links.outcome: Readability of AI-generated layperson summaries versus original abstracts (grade-level indices)
links.effect: Flesch-Kincaid grade fell from 12.55 (original) to 7.80 (GPT3.5) and 7.70 (GPT4), p<0.0001; reading ease rose from 33.29 to 68.45 and 69.55.

links.outcome: Physician-rated scientific accuracy of AI-generated layperson summaries
links.effect: 68.4% of GPT3.5 and 84.2% of GPT4 summaries maintained moderate scientific accuracy per two physician reviewers, so a substantial share did not.
links.quote: A total of 68.4% and 84.2% of GPT3.5- and GPT4-generated summaries, respectively, maintained moderate scientific accuracy according to the two physician-reviewers.

screen.reason: Evaluates the readability and physician-rated accuracy of ChatGPT-3.5 and ChatGPT-4 in summarizing neurosurgical abstracts for laypersons, without testing an organizational deployment safeguard or practice intervention.
